verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a browser-infrastructure platform, so the axis applies. However, every first-party item describes browsers 'running on Browserbase' via its hosted API, and none documents a self-hosted deployment. The community thread points users to BrowserStation as an open-source alternative, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
